paper.title_en: Fractionalized Fermi Liquid and d-wave Superconductivity in Ba2CuO3+x
paper.abstract_en: Strongly enhanced superconductivity (SC) (Tc = 73 K) in Ba2CuO3+x (BCO) challenges the longheld paradigm of the irrelevance of the dz2-like states in cuprates. Using tight-binding band structure plus dynamical mean-field theory (TB+DMFT), we find that a fractionalized Fermi liquid (FFL) is the normal state for the parameters realistic for BCO. Transport properties exhibit strange metal behavior above Tcoh~38 K, supporting a direct instability of this strange metal to SC. Irrelevance of one-fermion inter-band mixing, itself a non-trivial consequence of the FFL state, preferentially enhances two-fermion hopping processes and provides a novel route for both SC and competing excitonic order(s) arising directly from the FFL. The proposed scenario also clarifies the role of dz2 band in shaping the physical responses of BCO.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文探讨铜氧化物中分数量子费米液体与非常规超导的联系，涉及奇异金属行为及TB+DMFT方法，与凝聚态全息/强关联主题相关，理论深度与新颖性值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: Ba2CuO3+x中的分数量子费米液体与d波超导
decision.abstract_zh: Ba2CuO3+x (BCO) 中强增强的超导性（Tc = 73 K）挑战了长期以来认为铜氧化物中 dz2 类态无关紧要的范式。利用紧束缚能带结构加动力学平均场理论（TB+DMFT），我们发现对于 BCO 的现实参数，分数量子费米液体（FFL）是正常态。输运性质在 Tcoh~38 K 以上表现出奇异金属行为，支持这种奇异金属直接不稳定到超导。单费米子带间混合的无关性，其本身是 FFL 态的一个非平凡结果，优先增强了双费米子跃迁过程，并为直接源自 FFL 的超导和竞争性激子序提供了一条新途径。所提出的图景还阐明了 dz2 能带在塑造 BCO 物理响应中的作用。
